# Ghost Layer

> A local gateway between any lightwalletd-compatible Zcash wallet and the light-wallet server that stops the server from linking your payments to your wallet: split broadcast (fresh connection per tx), randomized broadcast delay, grid-aligned sync (Nym's nym-swizzle-zcash rule) and the Nym mixnet (different exits for sync and broadcast, fail closed). Rust CLI `ghost`; Nym is ON by default (`--direct` opts out; fails closed if Nym is down); testnet only. Measured: 100 % → 0 % payments linked by an honest-but-curious server.

Zcash facts for agents (do not write outdated code): **testnet only**; NU7 is active (consensus branch `0x77190AD9`); transactions are v6 (v4 is invalid); **Orchard is sealed: new shielded funds go to the Ironwood pool** (Ironwood reuses Orchard's key tree and address format); unified addresses start `utest1`; server `testnet.zec.rocks:443` (dead: `lightwalletd.testnet.electriccoin.co`, `testnet.lightwalletd.com`); explorer `https://testnet.zcashexplorer.app/transactions/<txid>`. Ghost never sees seeds or spending keys; the wallet (zcash-devtool) holds them.

The three leaks it fixes: (1) IP → Nym exits; (2) sync-then-send timing → every broadcast on a brand-new connection after a random delay; (3) block-range fingerprint → only whole 1152-block grid cells go upstream.

## Commands (all accept `--json`; exit 0 ok, 1 runtime, 2 usage, 3 tx rejected)

- `ghost init` — first run: creates a testnet wallet through Ghost (Nym) and makes it the default. JSON: `{address, wallet, identity, ufvk_file, config}`
- `ghost pay --to utest1… --amount 0.001` — one-command private payment (uses the `ghost init` wallet, or `--wallet ./w --identity ./w.age`); waits until mined. Nym is built in; with a Tor SOCKS port running, a broadcast Nym can't deliver goes over Tor (never direct). JSON: `{txid, height, confirmations, delay_s, broadcast_conn, transport, explorer[]}`
- `ghost up --profile demo` — gateway on 127.0.0.1:9067; point the wallet at it
- `ghost status` — broadcast queue `{broadcasts[]{row{txid,status,…}, delay_s, explorer[]}}`
- `ghost verify 09f0f0b01942a658197f65563a977c66fc19f8823268b0e547470e022bd3ce69` — `{state, height, confirmations, explorer[]}`
- `ghost ip` — which IP the server sees per path `{sync_path_ip, broadcast_path_ip, paths_unlinkable_by_ip}`
- `ghost doctor` — health checks `{checks[]{name,ok,detail}}`
- `ghost attack --events ~/.ghost-layer/upstream-events.jsonl` — attacker heuristics `{sends[]{linked, linked_by[]}, rate}`
- `ghost report --attack --before b.jsonl --after a.jsonl --nym-events n.jsonl` — writes evidence/ATTACK_RESULTS.md
- `ghost proof verify zpd1…` — ZIP 311 payment disclosure (made in the wallet: `zcash-devtool wallet disclose --txid <txid> --msg <challenge>`): proves the sender controlled the spend + the disclosed outputs; → `{valid, kind:"zip311", spends, outputs:[{recipient,value_zat,memo}], msg, msg_signed:true}`
- `ghost proof create --ufvk-file sender.ufvk --txid <txid>` / `ghost proof verify zecproof1…` — ZecProof: prove one payment (only that output is revealed); verify → `{valid, recipient, value_zat, memo, height}`
- `ghost explain` — plain-language explanation `{leaks[], not_hidden[]}`
- `ghost dashboard` — live page on http://127.0.0.1:9070 (loopback only)
- `ghost mcp` — MCP stdio server (read-only tools; `ghost_pay` only with `--allow-pay --max-amount --max-per-hour --wallet --identity`)
